desc: nxm Experiment 2: iterated conjecture estimation (3x2 game). Each round plays 2m=4 probe trials; the machine best-responds through its conjecture K plus +-delta offsets along each of its axes, then refits K by least squares on realized actions (damped). Prediction: median human action shifts from the human-led Stackelberg equilibrium toward the consistent conjectural variations equilibrium.
